{"originalLanguage":"en","id":"eu-oct09-com-cfd69a0af7c6","region":"EU","title":"EU gas system prepared for the winter despite lower storage levels","titleZh":"天然气协调小组：储气水平偏低，但欧盟气网可应对今冬","date":"2026-10-08","dateKind":"published","url":"https://energy.ec.europa.eu/news/eu-gas-system-prepared-winter-despite-lower-storage-levels-2026-10-08_en","sourceUrl":"https://commission.europa.eu/law/law-making-process_en","kind":"announcement","stage":"unverified","note":"10月8日天然气协调小组会议称储气低于往年，但液化天然气进口能力可弥补；委员会还介绍了明年初结束俄罗斯液化天然气长期合同的准备。这是形势评估，不设新的家庭义务或价格措施。","tags":[]}
